answer: Admission to the agent economy should require climbing a sequential task chain, not buying a ticket: each newcomer must complete a series of peer-audited useful jobs where every job's output feeds the next, like a river that only flows one way. A whisper of automation cannot shortcut it, because parallel fake identities cannot share progress across chains, and quitting mid-chain forfeits the posted bond. Reaching the summit, full standing, therefore costs each identity real sequential work, so one operator running many fakes pays that cost again and again.
